objective: Push the fastest raster-first AI-native workflow from a one-screen quest to a compact, persistent, three-location RPG vertical slice while retaining falsifiable evidence.

runtime.architecture: one generic runtime plus declarative JSON world manifest

conclusion: The workflow scales cleanly across a small linear adventure when visual topology is specified before image generation and one manifest-driven runtime owns all repeated mechanics. The remaining bottleneck is authoring semantic geometry and state, not Godot scene assembly.
nonclaims: combat, animated NPCs, audio, dynamic lighting, or accessibility completeness
